description: Native debug configurations, started by Debug: Start native debugger. One configuration, or several named ones.

name.description: The configuration's name, unique in the file.

type.description: The kind of program; Lightdown finds an installed adapter for it when adapter is left out.

request.description: Start the program, or attach to one that runs.

adapter.description: The adapter's command and arguments. {port} becomes a free loopback port for tcp.

transport.description: How Lightdown talks to the adapter: over its standard streams, or a TCP port.

launch.description: The launch or attach request's arguments, passed to the adapter unchanged after ${workspaceFolder}, ${file}, ${fileDirname}, ${relativeFile} and ${env:NAME} are filled in.

preLaunchTask.description: A project task (F6) that must succeed before the adapter starts.

cargo.description: Build with Cargo first and debug the executable it produces.

exceptionFilters.description: The adapter's exception breakpoint filters to turn on.

breakOnPanic.description: Stop when a Rust program panics.

default.description: The configuration to start when none is chosen.
